dimension: Donner Summit / I-80 budget ski cluster (Boreal, Soda Springs, Donner Ski Ranch, Sugar Bowl, Tahoe Donner, Royal Gorge) — 2026-27 pricing, multi-packs, and rentals for a San Jose skier

findings.name: Boreal Mountain Resort — iRide 4-Pack (THE BENCHMARK PRODUCT)
findings.claim: Boreal's iRide 4-Pack is live for 26/27 at $239 adult (ages 13+) and $179 child (12 & under), listed under the column header 'PRICE BEFORE 10/1'. Marketing is '4 visits for the price of 2' / 'pay for 3 lift tickets and receive a 4th FREE.' Page states: 'All 26/27 iRide must be purchased online', 'iRide Pass prices and benefits are valid all winter long until April 2027', and 'Pricing is tax-inclusive. A tax rate of 7.25% will be added upon checkout.' Tickets are valid 9am-8pm (includes night skiing). This is an exact match to the user's ~$240 / ~$60-a-day gold standard — it IS his gold standard deal, and it is still available at that price for the upcoming season. Affirm 0% APR payment plans offered. Lost pass reprint fee $10; passes are reloadable online to reuse the same OnePass card.
findings.restrictions: NO blackout dates (stated twice on the page). Must be purchased online — not sold on-site. Price shown is the 'BEFORE 10/1' rate, so 2026-10-01 is the effective purchase deadline for this rate; Boreal does not publish the post-10/1 price. Valid through April 2027. 7.25% tax added at checkout, so real out-the-door cost is ~$256.32 ($64.08/day).
findings.drive_time_from_san_jose: ~207 miles / ~3h35m via I-80 (Castle Peak / Boreal Ridge Rd exit, directly off the freeway — no mountain spur road)

findings.name: Boreal Mountain Resort — The Unlimited Pass (season pass)
findings.claim: 26/27 Boreal Unlimited Pass is $649 adult. Includes unlimited access 9am-8pm all season, ONE FREE KID'S SEASON PASS (ages 12 & under) with each adult pass purchased, buddy tickets, Woodward session vouchers, 1 free day at Soda Springs, 30% off group and private lessons, and 30% off Woodward daily sessions and 3-packs. Affirm payment plans available. Break-even vs. the $239 iRide 4-pack is roughly 11 days of skiing.
findings.restrictions: No blackout dates. Kids-ski-free perk is one free child pass per adult pass purchased.

findings.name: Boreal Mountain Resort — The Night Pass
findings.claim: 26/27 Boreal Night Pass is $219 for ALL AGES, giving unlimited access 3pm-8pm all season with no blackout dates. Includes buddy tickets and a Woodward session voucher, 30% off Woodward daily sessions and 3-packs. For a group that can leave San Jose at midday, this is the cheapest unlimited product in the whole cluster — cheaper than a single Sugar Bowl weekend day ticket pair.
findings.restrictions: Access limited to 3pm-8pm only. No blackout dates.

findings.name: Boreal Mountain Resort — Woodward Membership
findings.claim: Woodward Membership is $139/month with a minimum 4-month commitment (so ~$556 minimum), giving unlimited year-round Woodward Tahoe access plus unlimited Boreal Mountain access in winter and outdoor parks in summer. Monthly auto-pay.
findings.restrictions: Minimum 4-month commitment; auto-billed monthly.

findings.name: Boreal Mountain Resort — Go-Time day lift tickets (walk-up / advance)
findings.claim: Boreal sells day tickets as 'Go-Time' tickets: you buy online, pick a start time, and prices decrease progressively through the day. CRITICAL for group planning: 'Go Time tickets must be purchased before arriving and will not be sold on-site this year' — there is effectively NO walk-up window ticket at Boreal. Tickets valid from chosen start time to 8pm. Redemption via QR/barcode at Pick-Up Kiosks outside the Boreal Base Lodge. 26/27 Go-Time prices are NOT yet published on the site. For scale, OnTheSnow recorded a Dec 22 sample for LAST season (25/26) of $144 adult full-day and $124 adult half-day — which makes the $59.75/day iRide 4-pack roughly a 58% discount to a peak walk-up-equivalent rate.
findings.price_usd: 26-27 not published; 2025-26 sample $144 adult full day / $124 half day (OnTheSnow, Dec 22 sample)
findings.restrictions: Must be bought online in advance; not sold on-site. Dynamic/date-specific pricing, capacity-limited per start time. Date changes possible via guest services with fees/rate differences.

findings.name: Boreal Mountain Resort — on-site rentals
findings.claim: Boreal HAS on-site rentals: 'Lockers are located in Rentals on the first floor of the Boreal Lodge.' They offer ski and snowboard equipment packages only — 'No, we don't offer clothing rentals. We offer Ski and Snowboard equipment packages only.' Boreal's booking site lists a full ski + snowboard rental package at $59 and rental boots only at $29, and states 'There are no on-site purchases' — meaning rentals must be reserved/paid online in advance, same as lift tickets. NOTE: the rental price page I retrieved carries a Feb 2026 timestamp, so $59/$29 should be treated as the 25/26 rate and re-checked when 26/27 products load in the fall.
findings.restrictions: Must be pre-purchased online — no on-site purchases. Equipment packages only, no clothing rental. Group lesson packages bundle lift ticket + rental + lesson.

findings.name: Boreal Mountain Resort — Play Forever Fridays ($35 all-day)
findings.claim: Boreal runs 'Play Forever Fridays' — roughly nine select Fridays per season where an all-day ski, snowboard, tube, or Woodward bunker ticket is $35 per person, with $5 of each ticket donated to a local Truckee/Tahoe non-profit. Boreal's FAQ: 'One Friday per month, we offer $35 Lift Tickets, Bunker Sessions, and Tubing Tickets for Play Forever Friday!' This is the single cheapest lift-ticket day in the entire Donner Summit cluster and is ideal for a friends trip if the group can take a Friday off. The dates published on the site are the 25/26 calendar (Nov 21 2025, Dec 12 2025, Jan 9, Feb 6, Feb 27, Mar 13, Mar 20, Apr 3 2026); 26/27 dates are not yet posted.
findings.restrictions: Only valid on ~9 designated Fridays per season. 26/27 dates not yet announced. Boreal also notes it is NOT offering the old $15 young-adult Friday ticket due to capacity limits.

findings.name: Soda Springs — 26/27 Unlimited Pass
findings.claim: Soda Springs (Boreal's sister POWDR resort, 3 miles away) has 26/27 Unlimited Pass pricing live: Adult 24-59 $279 ($209 renewal), Young Adult 18-23 $264 ($199 renewal), Teen 13-17 $189 ($114 renewal), Child 6-12 $149 ($74 renewal), Micro 5 & under $64, Senior 60+ $94. Ages determined as of Nov 1, 2026. Includes 2 Buddy Passes (discounted friend tickets, valid 7 days/week non-holiday) and one 1-hour Woodward Bunker session. AT $279 FOR A FULL SEASON PASS, THIS UNDERCUTS THE $239 BOREAL 4-PACK ON A PER-DAY BASIS AFTER JUST 5 DAYS — a genuinely stronger deal than the user's benchmark if the smaller hill is acceptable.
findings.restrictions: Open-to-close 5 DAYS A WEEK (not 7) — the resort operates Mon, Thurs, Fri and weekends. No blackout dates. Renewal rates require a 25/26 Soda Springs pass and being logged in. PRICES INCREASE 10/1/2026 — hard purchase deadline. Only 2 chairlifts / 13-18 trails; beginner-oriented.
findings.drive_time_from_san_jose: ~205 miles / ~3h35m via I-80 (Soda Springs exit, ~3 miles west of Boreal)

findings.name: Soda Springs — 26/27 Family Pass
findings.claim: The 26/27 Soda Springs Family Pass is $579 before 10/1 ($499 renewal rate) and covers 2 Adult Unlimited Passes plus 2 Child passes (17 & under) — four people. Includes 2 chairlifts, all trails, Tube Town, Planet Kids, The Start Park, and The Sleigh. Additional children can be added for $89 each, on-site purchase only. Rentals not included but available. Perk: each pass carries 1 Boreal lift ticket voucher (2 vouchers per pass on the renewal tier), plus 30% off group/private lessons and Woodward sessions.
findings.per_day_usd: $144.75 per family-day at 4 visits; $28.95/person/day at 5 visits
findings.restrictions: PRICES INCREASE 10/1/2026. Open to close, 5 days a week, no blackout dates. Additional kids $89 each, on-site only. Renewal rate requires a 25/26 Family or Unlimited pass.

findings.name: Soda Springs — day lift tickets and rentals
findings.claim: Soda Springs uses the same dynamic 'choose your time & pay your price' model as Boreal. 'ONLINE ADVANCE PURCHASE LIFT TICKETS ARE REQUIRED TO SKI OR RIDE' — the resort is cash-free and an advance ticket is required just to access the resort, lodge and parking lot. There is one price for all ages. Tickets valid from start time to 4pm. Rentals ARE on site (first floor of the Soda Springs Lodge; packages include boots, skis or board, poles and helmet, all-day, due back 4pm) and are booked as a 'Rental Add-On' when purchasing the daily lift ticket. Neither 26/27 day-ticket nor 26/27 rental prices are published yet. For scale, OnTheSnow logged 25/26 samples of $89 weekday / $124 weekend adult.
findings.restrictions: Advance online purchase mandatory — no walk-up, cash-free resort. Ticket needed even for parking/lodge access. No refunds; unused dated tickets usable another day same season for a $20 on-site date-change fee. Shop opens 9AM Mon/Thurs/Fri and 8AM weekends.

findings.name: Donner Ski Ranch — 26/27 Adult Season Pass
findings.claim: Donner Ski Ranch's 2026-2027 Adult Season Pass (ages 18-69) is on sale at $549, marked down from a $599 original price. Terms: 'Ski or Ride 9 am - 4 pm, Seven Days a Week, with zero blackout dates' plus free parking all season. Your age on 12/1/2026 determines pass type. The full 26/27 pass lineup spans $149 to $549 across age tiers. All passes are physical and must be picked up at the ticket window on your first ski day.
findings.restrictions: Zero blackout dates, 7 days/week, 9am-4pm (NO night skiing). ALL SALES FINAL — no returns, cancellations, refunds, transfers, and no refunds for road conditions or unused purchases. No guarantee of weather, open terrain, grooming, or number of operating lifts. Physical pass pickup required at the window.
findings.drive_time_from_san_jose: ~208 miles / ~3h40m via I-80 to Soda Springs/Norden exit then Donner Pass Rd

findings.name: Donner Ski Ranch — day tickets, Old School Days, and rentals
findings.claim: DSR's posted price table is still explicitly labeled 'Pricing 2025 - 2026' — 26/27 day-ticket and rental rates are NOT yet published. Last season's rates: Adult (18-69) $119 all day / $99 half day / $69 Old School Days; Youth 13-17 $109/$89/$69; Child 6-12 $69/$59/$39; Senior 70+ $109/$89/$69. Snow tubing $39 ($34 Old School). CRITICAL LOGISTICS WARNING for a group trip: 'Purchase tickets and rentals in person only at the ticket window, the day of your visit! WE DO NOT SELL TICKETS OR RENTALS ONLINE - NO RESERVATIONS' and 'We do not sell multi-day tickets; every ticket is sold only day by day in person, not in advance.' So DSR has NO 4-pack, NO advance purchase, and NO rental reservations — rentals are first-come, first-served and they explicitly do not do seasonal rentals. Free parking. 'Old School Days' ran Tuesdays/Wednesdays/Thursdays from Jan 6, 2026, excluding Feb 17-19, 2026.
findings.restrictions: No online sales, no reservations, no multi-day packs, no advance purchase — window only, day of. Rentals first-come first-served, no seasonal rentals. 9am-4pm, no night skiing. Old School Days are Tue/Wed/Thu only with a holiday-week exclusion. Groups of 20+ get 10% off tickets, tubing and rentals plus 2 free group-leader tickets, but must book 5+ days ahead.

findings.name: Donner Ski Ranch — on-site rentals
findings.claim: DSR rentals are on site in the lodge, opening at 8am, first-come first-served with no reservations required or accepted. Last season's rates: Adult/Youth/Senior $55 regular day, $30 on Old School Days; Child 6-12 $45 regular, $30 Old School; 5 & under $25/$15; helmet only $16; poles only $12. Explicitly: 'WE DO NOT DO SEASONAL RENTALS'. A midweek Old School Day combo of $69 lift + $30 rental = $99 all-in per adult is the cheapest complete lift+gear day in the cluster.
findings.price_usd: $55 adult regular day; $30 adult Old School Days
findings.restrictions: First-come, first-served; no reservations; no seasonal rentals; purchase in person day-of in the lodge. Rental department opens 8am. 2025-26 pricing — 26/27 not yet posted.

findings.name: Sugar Bowl — 26/27 multi-day ticket packs (the closest thing to a Boreal 4-pack at a real mountain)
findings.claim: Sugar Bowl launched new Multi-Day Ticket Packs for 26/27, announced on its own site July 1, 2026: (1) ANYTIME 3-PACK at $199/day — three days, zero blackout dates, any day the lifts spin including weekends and holidays; (2) SELECT 3-PACK at $99/day — Sunday through Friday, non-holiday; (3) MIDWEEK MAGIC PACK at $89/day — Monday through Thursday. Article states 'Buy early to lock in the lowest pre-season rates before prices go up.' The Select 3-Pack at $99/day (~$297 for three days) is the most direct competitor to Boreal's $59.75/day iRide, at roughly 1.65x the per-day cost but on a vastly bigger mountain (105 trails, 12 lifts, most snow in Tahoe). For reference, last season's Select 3-pack was $109/ticket ($329 total), so the 26/27 pre-season rate is a genuine improvement.
findings.restrictions: Anytime: no blackouts. Select: Sunday-Friday, non-holiday only. Midweek Magic: Monday-Thursday. Pre-season rates rise as the season nears; exact increase dates not published. Sugar Bowl's ticket page notes lift tickets, lessons and rentals for 26/27 'will become available for booking this fall', so pack availability may be intermittent right now.
findings.drive_time_from_san_jose: ~205 miles / ~3h30m via I-80, Soda Springs/Norden exit (Sugar Bowl Rd) — closest big mountain to the Bay on I-80

findings.name: Sugar Bowl — 26/27 day lift tickets (online vs window)
findings.claim: Sugar Bowl publishes a stark advance-vs-window spread for 26/27. Sunday-Friday: Adult (23-64) $89 online starting rate vs $189 window; Young Adult 13-22 $77 vs $149; Senior 65-74 $84 vs $159; Child 6-12 $49 vs $109; Super Senior 75+ $49 vs $109; 5 & under free. Saturday + Holiday: Adult $114 online vs $249 window; Young Adult $90 vs $189; Senior $96 vs $199; Child $66 vs $139. Site says 'Grab yours early and save up to 50%' and 'Walk-up tickets are limited and sold at the daily rate to keep lift lines light.' Buying at the window on a Saturday costs $249 — more than a full Soda Springs season pass. Reserved Upper Lot parking is an extra $35 on weekends/holidays.
findings.price_usd: Adult: $89 online Sun-Fri / $189 window; $114 online Sat+holiday / $249 window
findings.restrictions: Online starting rates are dynamic and rise with demand — only the earliest buyers get $89/$114. Walk-up window tickets are deliberately limited. Date-specific tickets. Weekend/holiday parking $35 extra if reserved. Booking for 26/27 opens in fall 2026 — the price table is posted but the products are not yet loaded, so treat as indicative.

findings.name: Sugar Bowl — 26/27 season passes
findings.claim: Sugar Bowl 26/27 season passes: UNRESTRICTED Adult (23-64) $1,399, Young Adult (13-22) $949, Senior (65-74) $949, Super Senior 75+ and Kids 6-12 $579 (unrestricted combo), Child 5 & under free — no blackout dates, 8 friends-and-family 50%-off tickets, 50% off at 26 Mountain Collective resorts, free spring access ($399 value). SLIGHTLY RESTRICTED $999 adult / $749 young adult & senior, 6 F&F tickets. MIDWEEK $599 adult / $569 young adult, senior, super senior, 4 F&F tickets. LOCAL STUDENT $249 (Nevada/Placer/Washoe county school districts). UPHILL PASS $249 all ages. All passes include uphill access. Multi-Sport Pass (Sugar Bowl + Royal Gorge + uphill) starting at $668.
findings.price_usd: Unrestricted $1,399 adult / $949 young adult; Slightly Restricted $999; Midweek $599
findings.restrictions: Unrestricted: no blackouts. Slightly Restricted blackouts: 12/26/26-12/31/26, 1/16/27-1/17/27, 2/13/27-2/14/27. Midweek: valid Mon-Fri only, blackouts 12/26/26-12/31/26, 1/18/27, 2/15/27. NO-QUESTIONS-ASKED FULL REFUND UNTIL AUGUST 31, 2026 — after Sept 1 passes are non-refundable. That refund deadline is 3 days away as of today. Add-ons: Royal Gorge $249 adult, preferred parking $799, seasonal locker $900-$2,400.

findings.name: Sugar Bowl — on-site rentals and beginner package
findings.claim: Sugar Bowl has slopeside on-site rentals bookable online (shop.sugarbowl.com rental package) plus a demo ski program. It advertises a 'First Time Ski & Ride Pack' for $99 — highly relevant for beginner friends on a group trip. Exact 26/27 rental package prices are not yet published; the site states lift tickets, lessons and rentals for the 2026/27 season 'will become available for booking this fall.' Sugar Bowl advises booking lessons, rentals and lift tickets in advance to save up to 50% off window rates.
findings.price_usd: Rental package price not published for 26/27; First Time Ski & Ride Pack $99
findings.restrictions: 26/27 rental products not loaded yet — booking opens fall 2026. Rentals bookable online alongside lift tickets.

findings.name: Tahoe Donner Downhill Ski Resort — 26/27 season passes
findings.claim: Tahoe Donner 26/27 Downhill Ski Season Passes (PUBLIC rates, i.e. non-homeowners): Adult 18-59 $676, Junior 7-17 $436, Senior 60+ $436, Child 6 & under $129. Member (Tahoe Donner property owner) rates are far lower: Adult $421, Junior $289, Senior $296. Combo Cross Country + Downhill: Adult public $919 / member $631. Ages as of Dec 31, 2026. The 26/27 season centers on a brand-new ski lodge with easy lift access, enhanced cafeteria and bar, kids' ski school room and sun deck. NOTE: the pass price already increased — the site warned 'SEASON PASS PRICES INCREASE AUG. 18' and OnTheSnow's April 2026 snapshot listed the adult pass at $637, versus $676 now.
findings.price_usd: $676 adult public; $436 junior/senior public; $919 adult combo
findings.restrictions: Unrestricted (no blackouts) at these tiers. 26/27 holiday peak periods: Dec 26 2026-Jan 2 2027, Jan 16-18 2027, Feb 13-20 2027. Member Super Senior 70+ pass is midweek/non-holiday only. The Aug. 18, 2026 price-increase deadline has already passed. Passholder perks for 26/27 are listed as 'coming soon'.
findings.drive_time_from_san_jose: ~215 miles / ~3h45m via I-80 to Truckee, then into the Tahoe Donner subdivision (Snowpeak Way) — slightly further and more off-highway than Boreal

findings.name: Tahoe Donner Downhill — day tickets and rentals
findings.claim: Tahoe Donner day tickets are dynamically priced and 26/27 public rates are NOT published. The site states: 'Purchase lift tickets in advance to ensure the best rates', 'Take advantage of advanced purchase discounts of up to 25% off the window rate', and 'Members always receive the best prices, starting at $55 per day for adults.' Important group caveat: 'Tahoe Donner no longer offers advance purchase of guest lift tickets. Guest rates are only available at the Downhill Ski Resort on the day of purchase and require the accompanying presence of a Member Photo ID cardholder' — so a group of friends without a member host pays full public rates. On-site rentals exist (Völkl, Burton, Rossignol, Dalbello, Marker gear) with multi-day rental supported: keep the gear, extra days charged on return, and return by 9AM to avoid a charge for a day you skip. Rental prices not published for 26/27. Terrain is 40% beginner / 60% intermediate, explicitly pitched at beginners, families and groups of 20+.
findings.price_usd: 26-27 public day rates not published; member rate 'starting at $55/day' adult; up to 25% off window with advance purchase
findings.restrictions: Guest (member-accompanied) discount rates are day-of only and require a member present. All participants need a valid ticket AND equipment — no pedestrians on conveyors or learning areas. Dynamic pricing; buy early. 26/27 peak holiday dates: Dec 26 2026-Jan 2 2027, Jan 16-18 2027, Feb 13-20 2027.

findings.name: Royal Gorge — NOT a downhill option
findings.claim: Royal Gorge is cross-country and snowshoe ONLY — it has no downhill/alpine skiing and therefore no downhill-relevant deals. Sugar Bowl's own pass chart describes the Royal Gorge pass as 'Valid 7 days/week at Royal Gorge only for cross-country skate, classic or snowshoe access.' 26/27 Royal Gorge season pass prices: Adult (23-64) $449, Senior (65-74) $369, Young Adult (13-22) $159, Kids 6-12 and Super Senior 75+ $79, Local Student $69, Child 5 & under free. It can be added to any Sugar Bowl alpine pass for $249 adult / $99 senior & young adult. Royal Gorge covers 140km+ of trails across 6,000 acres. Rule it out for this trip unless the group wants a Nordic day.
findings.price_usd: $449 adult XC season pass; $249 as an add-on to a Sugar Bowl alpine pass
findings.restrictions: Cross-country skate/classic and snowshoe only. No alpine terrain, no lifts, no downhill day tickets. No blackout dates on the pass.
findings.drive_time_from_san_jose: ~205 miles / ~3h30m via I-80, adjacent to Sugar Bowl on Donner Summit

findings.name: Donner Summit cluster — cross-resort verdict vs. the $240 benchmark
findings.claim: Ranked by adult cost per ski day for a 4-day season, all confirmed 2026-27 unless noted: (1) Soda Springs Unlimited Pass $279 = $69.75/day at 4 days and drops to $55.80 at 5 and $27.90 at 10 — the only product that BEATS the benchmark if you ski 5+ days, though on a 2-lift beginner hill; (2) Boreal iRide 4-Pack $239 = $59.75/day, no blackouts, night skiing to 8pm — still the best fixed 4-day deal in the cluster and the strongest all-round pick; (3) Boreal Night Pass $219 all ages, unlimited 3pm-8pm = $54.75/day at 4 nights and falls from there; (4) Sugar Bowl Select 3-Pack $99/day Sun-Fri — 1.65x the benchmark but a genuinely large mountain; (5) Sugar Bowl Midweek Magic $89/day Mon-Thu; (6) Donner Ski Ranch Old School Days $69/day Tue-Thu (25/26 price) with $30 rentals, cheapest lift+gear combo at ~$99 all-in; (7) Tahoe Donner adult pass $676 = $169/day at 4 days, poor value for a small group of occasional skiers. For the user's stated use case — proposing trips to friends, beginner-friendly, rentals on site, total per-person cost — Boreal remains the correct anchor and its benchmark deal is still on the table at exactly the price he remembers.
findings.price_usd: Boreal iRide $239 / Soda Springs Unlimited $279 / Sugar Bowl Select 3-Pack ~$297
findings.restrictions: Two hard deadlines are imminent: Soda Springs 26/27 pass prices increase 10/1/2026, and Boreal's iRide $239 is a 'PRICE BEFORE 10/1' rate. Sugar Bowl's no-questions-asked pass refund window closes 8/31/2026. Donner Ski Ranch cannot be pre-bought at all — window only, day of, no packs.
findings.drive_time_from_san_jose: All Donner Summit resorts are ~3h30m-3h45m from San Jose via I-880/I-680 to I-80; Boreal, Soda Springs, Sugar Bowl and Donner Ski Ranch cluster within ~6 miles of each other at the summit

coverage_gaps: Boreal's iRide 4-Pack price AFTER the 10/1 deadline is not published anywhere — the site only shows the 'PRICE BEFORE 10/1' column, so I cannot say how much it rises or whether the product stays available.

Boreal 26/27 Go-Time day lift ticket prices are not published (dynamic, date-and-start-time specific, loaded closer to the season). I only have a 2025-26 OnTheSnow sample of $144 adult full day, which is a secondary source.

Boreal 26/27 rental package prices are unconfirmed. The $59 package / $29 boots figures come from Boreal's booking site with a Feb 2026 timestamp, so they are almost certainly 25/26 rates. Boreal's own /day-access/rentals/ page renders no price table.
Boreal 26/27 blackout/holiday dates and the 26/27 Play Forever Friday calendar are not yet posted; the FAQ still lists the 25/26 Friday dates and the $35 price from last season.

Donner Ski Ranch 26/27 day-ticket, half-day, Old School Days and rental prices are NOT published — their pricing page is still explicitly headed 'Pricing 2025 - 2026'. All DSR daily/rental figures I report are last season's.

Donner Ski Ranch 26/27 season pass tiers other than Adult ($549) could not be individually confirmed. The SimpleTix listing gives only an aggregate range of $149.00-$549.00; the youth/child/senior product URLs 404 and the SimpleTix widget is JavaScript-rendered.

Soda Springs 26/27 day lift ticket prices and rental package prices are not published (dynamic pricing, products load closer to the season). The 25/26 samples of $89 weekday / $124 weekend come from OnTheSnow, a secondary source.

Sugar Bowl's 26/27 multi-day pack figures ($199 / $99 / $89 per day) come from a Sugar Bowl-authored article dated July 1, 2026; I could not confirm them against the live shop, which returned HTTP 403, and the /3pack landing page served stale end-of-last-season content. Total pack prices and exact expiry/price-increase dates are unconfirmed.
Sugar Bowl's 26/27 day-ticket table is posted but the page simultaneously says tickets 'will become available for booking this fall', so I could not verify those rates against a live checkout.
Sugar Bowl 26/27 rental package prices are not published.
Tahoe Donner 26/27 PUBLIC day lift ticket prices and all rental prices are not published — only the member floor of '$55 per day for adults' and 'up to 25% off the window rate' for advance purchase.

I did not verify any San Jose / South Bay rental shop options (Sports Basement, local shops) — that was outside this Donner Summit cluster assignment and I have no confirmed South Bay rental pricing to report. The only Bay-Area pickup lead I saw was an unverified blog mention of Sports Basement in Berkeley.

Night skiing is confirmed only at Boreal (lifts to 8pm, Night Pass 3pm-8pm). I found no evidence of night skiing at Soda Springs (tickets run to 4pm), Donner Ski Ranch (9am-4pm), Sugar Bowl or Tahoe Donner, but I did not find an explicit statement ruling it out at Sugar Bowl or Tahoe Donner.

Drive times are from route-planning aggregators (Rome2rio ~207 mi / 3h37m to Boreal), not measured; winter conditions, chain controls and I-80 traffic can add hours and none of the resorts publish a San Jose drive time.
